response.text: {"question":"As of 28 May 2022, how must a MiFID investment firm interpret references to ‘Directive 2014/56/EU’, ‘investment services and activities’, ‘relevant persons’, and ‘Article 25(2) of this Regulation’ in the Article 22 Compliance Requirements?","answer":"The firm must treat ‘Directive 2014/56/EU’ as ‘the regulatory system’; ‘investment services and activities’ (or ‘investment services, activities’) as ‘financial services and activities’; ‘relevant persons’ remain ‘relevant persons’; and ‘Article 25(2) of this Regulation’ as ‘General Organisational Requirements 4.1A’.","answerable":true}
